title: An ontology for cross-sectoral crisis management: core and public health modules
abstract: arXiv:2610.01326v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper presents the European Crisis Management Ontology (ECMO), a modular OWL-based ontology intended as a cross-sectoral reference for disaster risk reduction and response. ECMO is designed to be organised as a network of ontological modules. Among the modules, ECMO-CORE captures fundamental crisis management concepts such as hazard, event, exposure, impact, and response measure and uses ontology design patterns and the OWL2 punning technique to resolve ambiguities between hazard types and event manifestations. In addition, domain-specific modules are defined as in the case of the public health module aligned with SNOMED CT and ICD-11. To demonstrate the resource's utility, we used ECMO to represent the data of the Epidemic Intelligence from Open Sources system of the Joint Research Centre to generate an end-to-end pipeline that populates an ECMO-compliant knowledge graph from unstructured epidemiological news. translated_title: 面向跨部门危机管理的本体：核心模块与公共卫生模块
translated_abstract: 本文提出了欧洲危机管理本体（ECMO），这是一个基于OWL的模块化本体，旨在作为减少灾害风险与响应的跨部门参考标准。ECMO被设计为以本体模块网络的形式进行组织。在这些模块中，ECMO-CORE捕捉了基本的危机管理概念，如危害、事件、暴露、影响和应对措施，并使用本体设计模式和OWL2 punning技术来解决危害类型与事件表现之间的歧义。此外，还定义了领域特定的模块，例如与SNOMED CT和ICD-11对齐的公共卫生模块。为了展示该资源的实用性，我们使用ECMO来表示联合研究中心开源流行病情报系统的数据，构建了一个端到端的流水线，从非结构化的流行病学新闻中填充符合ECMO的知识图谱。初步结果表明……
tldr: 本文提出了欧洲危机管理本体（ECMO），一个基于OWL的模块化跨部门危机管理参考本体，包含核心模块和与SNOMED CT及ICD-11对齐的公共卫生模块，并通过从非结构化流行病学新闻构建知识图谱的端到端流水线展示了其实用价值。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the European Crisis Management Ontology (ECMO), a modular OWL-based cross-sectoral reference ontology for crisis management comprising core and public health modules aligned with SNOMED CT and ICD-11, and demonstrates its utility through an end-to-end pipeline that populates an ECMO-compliant knowledge graph from unstructured epidemiological news.
